name: Furina
notes: KQM and Game8 agree on 4pc Golden Troupe, HP% sands or ER, HP% or Hydro DMG goblet, CRIT circlet, Splendor of Tranquil Waters first. Her Burst buffs the team and her Skill's Salon members (Max HP-scaling, elemental curve) deal the damage, so the damage talent is the Skill while the leveling order is Burst first (both sources). Goals: HP 35,000-40,000 (37,500 used), CRIT Rate 60-80 (70), CRIT DMG 160-200 (180) and ER 180+ are Game8's; KQM's ER depends on teammates (180-210 with one teammate Skill, 130-150 with Neuvillette). The kit's Fanfare conversion ratio line (marked 'check') is a buff ratio, not a multiplier. She is a sub-DPS support, so no ATK goal. Partners are inferred (Hydro for Neuvillette double Hydro, Pyro and Electro for Vaporize and Hyperbloom teams); the sources give no team list.
